app_events.details: Rider R-5879 booked trip RYDE-CS-010 from Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park Carpark C to Thomson Medical Centre. Pickup 15:00.
Driver D-3047 (Lee Kim Huat, Nissan Serena (SLC 2975 H)) assigned.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Arrival recorded for the pickup point.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Wait timer started at driver arrival. 3 min free wait period ends at 15:01.
Free 3-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded.
Cancel pressed by driver D-3047. Reason selected: rider_no_show.
Cancellation fee S$6.00 charged to rider payment method (credit_card).
Driver D-3047 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: Records conflict on whether the driver was at the pickup. The driver_arrived event is recorded at 14:58:00 and the driver cancelled at 15:09:00 (11 minutes after that, past the 8-minute threshold), but the GPS telemetry places the driver about 900 m south of the pickup point (lat 1.3559 vs 1.3640) at 14:58 and for the whole wait, and the rider's 15:03 chat says she saw no car. If the driver was never at the pickup the wait does not count and no fee is due; if the arrival is accurate the fee is due. The evidence cannot settle this, so a person must decide.
